dedupe_keys.name: nature based solutions tools catalogue act on nbs 70 tools

description: This catalogue lists 70 tools for planning, designing and implementing nature-based solutions for climate resilient cities, where a tool is a methodology, software, catalogue, repository, e-platform, guideline or handbook. It was compiled in the EIT Climate-KIC project Adaptive Cities Through Integrated Nature-Based Solutions (ACT on NBS) from interviews with EU municipalities, workshops and a desk review of international organisations, EU projects and scientific and grey literature, and each tool is assessed so that end users can find one that fits a specific environmental challenge. It was prepared by Monserrat Budding-Polo Ballinas, Helena Hulsman, Claudia de Luca and Reinder Brolsma of Wageningen, Deltares and Bologna, and is downloadable free as a single Excel file from Zenodo (September 2020, CC BY 4.0); a follow-up article in Sustainability (2021) analyses it. Caveats: it is a 2020 snapshot, several listed tools may have moved or closed, and the assessment is qualitative. It supports selection of nature-based solution models and decision tools for adaptation studies; a related record is the Oppla nature-based solutions repository.
